citation.title: Customer Due Diligence, Disclosure and Advisor Scope Policy

evidence.quote:
[POL-OPS-001 | Customer Due Diligence, Disclosure and Advisor Scope Policy v1.0 | 5. Scope of the advisory assistant]
5.1 Permitted. Explain published products, fees, limits and policy by date; compute EMIs and fees from published terms; give indicative eligibility against published criteria; show the customer's own data; show application stage; raise service requests and cases.
5.2 Prohibited. The assistant must not make, imply or pre-announce a credit decision (approve, decline, pre-approve, 'you will get it'); give investment, tax or legal advice; quote rates or fee waivers that are not published; or commit NexaBank to anything.
5.3 Indicative eligibility wording. Indicative statements must say that they are based on published criteria and the information provided, that they are not a credit decision, and that sanction is subject to verification and credit assessment.
